AUTHOR: Zhang
TITLE: An Improved YOLOv8n Used for Fish Detection in Natural Water Environments
REGION: Moreton Bay, Queensland, Australia; Høyegga and Myggbukta, Inlandet, Norway
SPECIES: Australasian snapper, blue catfish, eastern striped grunter, paradise threadfin bream, smallmouth scad, smooth golden toadfish, yellowfin bream, bleak, perch
DATA: Merged: Moreton Bay Environmental Education Centre BRUV videos 2017-2021 (Zenodo 5238512) + NINA/NTNU Norwegian freshwater fish videos
V_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'baited underwater video setup at a depth of 2-5 m... under natural lighting conditions... with water visibility limited to the measured Secchi depth.'
D_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'we deleted highly similar images in the original dataset... randomly divided into a training set and a test set using random sampling in a 7:3 ratio.'
R_EV: Sec. 4.4: 'the dataset constructed by this study was used for testing.'
C_EV: Sec. 4.6: 'the input image size was set to 640 x 640, and the confidence threshold was set to 0.25.'
E_EV: Sec. 5: only 'mAP@50 and mAP@50:95 increased by 1.9% and 2.4%'; duplicate counting noted as future work
ARCH: BSSFISH-YOLOv8 (YOLOv8n + SPD-Conv, BiFormer, small-target detection layer)
METR: precision, recall, mAP@50, mAP@50:95, params, FLOPs
NOTE: Secchi depth mentioned but no value reported -> V1 coded qualitative. Depth 2-5 m (V2) and natural lighting/daylight (V3) reported for source data. D3=Y for deletion of 'highly similar images' (stated to reduce overfitting, not leakage -> D4=N). NIMG approximate ('about 2000 photos'); Table 1 counts are per-class sample totals. Norwegian data platform not described (PLAT 혼합). Confidence threshold 0.25 used for visual comparison, default. Code 'can be requested' -> CODE=N.
